title: RedEvoAgent: Automatic Red-Teaming Agent with Experience-Driven Skill Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.27439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in product-level execution harnesses, where jailbreaks can trigger harmful tool use and persistent state changes, creating greater risks than unsafe text generation alone. Existing automatic red-teaming methods often rely on fixed attacks, while recent agentic attackers coordinate multiple jailbreak tools and show stronger potential through trajectory-based retrieval. However, such retrieval can reuse misleading experiences due to retrieval bias and unclear tool credit, and full trajectories add context overhead while reducing interpretability. We propose RedEvoAgent, a black-box red-teaming agent that distills cross-case attack trajectories into a concise, human-readable attack skill. The attack skill adaptively evolves through tool-effectiveness profiling and Deciding-Tool Attribution for skill updates, and a validation ratchet that retains only updates improving validation performance. translated_title: RedEvoAgent：具有经验驱动技能进化的自动红队智能体
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体越来越多地部署在产品级执行环境中，其中越狱攻击可能触发有害工具使用和持久状态变化，造成比单纯不安全文本生成更大的风险。现有的自动红队方法通常依赖固定攻击，而最近的智能体攻击者协调多种越狱工具，并通过基于轨迹的检索展现出更强的潜力。然而，这种检索可能因检索偏差和工具归属不清而重用误导性经验，且完整轨迹增加了上下文开销并降低了可解释性。我们提出RedEvoAgent，一个黑盒红队智能体，将跨案例攻击轨迹提炼为简洁、人类可读的攻击技能。该攻击技能通过工具有效性分析和决策工具归属进行技能更新的自适应进化，并采用验证棘轮机制，仅保留能提升验证性能的更新。实验...
tldr: RedEvoAgent通过将攻击轨迹提炼为可读技能，并利用工具归因和验证棘轮机制实现自适应进化，从而提升黑盒红队攻击的有效性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: RedEvoAgent enhances black-box red-teaming by distilling attack trajectories into readable skills and adaptively evolving them via tool attribution and a validation ratchet, improving effectiveness and interpretability.
